nodes.title: Understand task boundary
nodes.detail: Classified as command. Use the graph state, current files, memory, skills, MCP registry, and tool results as evidence.

nodes.title: Use retrieved memory
nodes.detail: Fold relevant project memory/RAG into reasoning when it changes the implementation path.

nodes.title: Use matched skills
nodes.detail: Apply progressively loaded skill guidance when relevant: react-vite-typescript, gh-fix-ci, investigation-mode, frontend-testing-debugging.

nodes.title: Choose tools from evidence gaps
nodes.detail: Request local tool or MCP actions only when they answer a concrete uncertainty; use returned observations in the next graph pass.

nodes.title: Act on the repository
nodes.detail: Return concrete file changes and/or project-scoped shell actions once enough evidence exists.

nodes.title: Validate with available commands
nodes.detail: Use the validation plan and shell policy to request build/test/lint/typecheck commands when they materially improve confidence.

nodes.title: Keep app-scale structure
nodes.detail: Preserve clear module boundaries, state shape, error/loading flows, and validation hooks when the task is app-scale.

checkpoints.title: Context and constraints
checkpoints.detail: Map repo shape, relevant files, stack, user constraints, memory, skills, and available tools before changing code.

checkpoints.title: Coherent implementation
checkpoints.detail: Make the smallest coherent file set that solves the product/code goal without unrelated rewrites.

checkpoints.title: Validation and repair
checkpoints.detail: Run or request the strongest available build/test/lint/typecheck/preview checks, then repair failures.

checkpoints.title: Preview quality
checkpoints.detail: Check visible UX depth, responsive behavior, broken runtime, placeholder residue, and interaction integrity.

checkpoints.title: Handoff summary
checkpoints.detail: Summarize what changed, what was verified, and any remaining blocker or follow-up.

completion_criteria: User intent and project boundary are reflected in the implementation.
Changed files are coherent with imports, routes, styles, and state.
Validation/build/test evidence is requested or recorded when available.
Blocking verifier, runtime, or preview issues are repaired or explicitly reported.
risk_register: Missing credentials or external service access may block live integration.
Large UI changes can regress responsive layout without preview evidence.
